info.title: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - Client
info.description: Platform Client Service (PCS) API provides client cache details and wireless/wired client health grid information.

servers.description: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - Client

tags.name: GDPR
tags.description: GDPR compliance audit log, client report and client data deletion operations

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a wireless client using the client UUID from the grid response.
Retrieves detailed information about a wired client using the client UUID from the grid response.

post.description: Returns the client data of Wired devices based on the provided filters.
Returns the client health grid of Wired devices based on the provided filters.
Returns the client data of Wireless devices based on the provided filters.
Returns the client health grid of Wireless devices based on the provided filters.
Lookup and retrieve basic client information based on a list of MAC addresses (max 100). It support both wired and wireless clients.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the list of MAC addresses to lookup (hexadecimal format without separators)

get.description: Retrieves IPv4 routing information for a specific device with pagination support. Returns routing details including destination, VLAN information, route origin, status, metrics, next hop details, and ping protection settings.

200.description: Successfully retrieved device IPv4 routing information

post.description: Returns the client health filter metadata of Wired devices.

post.summary: Check RTTS support for multiple clients
post.description: Checks if Route Table Tracking Support (RTTS) is supported for a list of clients. Takes client details including clientId, deviceId, and connectionStatus, and returns whether RTTS is supported for each client. Maximum 500 clients can be validated in a single request.

200.description: Successfully checked RTTS support for all clients

get.description: Returns a paginated, optionally sorted and filtered list of GDPR audit-log entries for the caller's tenant.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the GDPR audit log page

WirelessClientHealthGridRequest.description: Request parameters for filtering and querying wireless client health grid data with advanced filtering capabilities

site_ids.description: List of site identifiers to filter wireless clients by specific locations

device_ids.description: List of access point device identifiers to filter clients connected to specific APs

items.description: Unique identifier of an access point device

column_name.description:
The column name to apply the filter on. Supported columns:
- RSSI
- SNR

filter_type.description:
The type of numeric filter to apply:
- GT: Greater Than
- GTE: Greater Than or Equal
- LT: Less Than
- LTE: Less Than or Equal
- EQ: Equal
- NEQ: Not Equal
- BTW: Between (uses min and max values)
- BLANK: Field is blank/null
- NOT_BLANK: Field is not blank/null

value.description:
The value to compare against for the filter (used for GT, GTE, LT, LTE, EQ, NEQ).
Units:
  - For RSSI: dBm
  - For SNR: dB
  The unit should match the column_name value.

min.description:
The minimum value for the BTW (Between) filter type.
Units:
  - For RSSI: dBm
  - For SNR: dB
The unit should match the column_name value.

max.description:
The maximum value for the BTW (Between) filter type.
Units:
  - For RSSI: dBm
  - For SNR: dB
The unit should match the column_name value.

BulkClientIdsRequest.description: Request body carrier for the bulk GDPR endpoints (report / delete). Client MAC addresses are resolved server-side to their client ids before the operation is performed; MACs that do not resolve to a known client are skipped.

status.description: Processing status of the bulk request.

operation.description: The bulk operation that was performed.

accepted.description: Number of client ids (resolved from the supplied MAC addresses) that were processed.

KeywordWired.name: keyword
KeywordWired.description:
Keyword for case-insensitive exact match across multiple wired client fields:
- client_mac: Client MAC address (e.g., "8899AA000101")

Returns results where any of these fields exactly matches the keyword (case-insensitive).

KeywordWireless.name: keyword
KeywordWireless.description:
Keyword for case-insensitive exact match across multiple fields:
- client_mac: Client MAC address (e.g., "8899AA000101")

Returns results where any of these fields exactly matches the keyword (case-insensitive).

GdprSize.name: size
GdprSize.description: Number of items to return per page. Values above the maximum are clamped to it.

GdprSort.name: sort
GdprSort.description: Field to sort by. When omitted, the default database ordering is used. Requires `order` to be omitted or supplied together.

GdprOrder.name: order
GdprOrder.description: Sort direction, case-insensitive. Only valid when `sort` is also supplied; defaults to `ASC` when `sort` is present but `order` is omitted.

GdprStatus.name: status
GdprStatus.description: Filter by job status, case-insensitive. Accepts multiple values: either repeat the parameter (`status=COMPLETED&status=PROCESSING`) or pass a comma-separated list (`status=COMPLETED,PROCESSING`). A row matches if its status equals any of the supplied values.

GdprCategory.name: category
GdprCategory.description: Filter by job category, case-insensitive. Accepts multiple values: either repeat the parameter (`category=Delete Client Data&category=Generate Client Report`) or pass a comma-separated list. A row matches if its category equals any of the supplied values.

GdprStartTime.name: startTime
GdprStartTime.description: Inclusive lower bound for the entry's creation time, epoch milliseconds.

GdprEndTime.name: endTime
GdprEndTime.description: Inclusive upper bound for the entry's creation time, epoch milliseconds. Must not be before `startTime` when both are supplied.

GdprTimeZone.name: timeZone
GdprTimeZone.description: IANA time zone id (e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`) or offset (e.g. `+05:30`) used to render the `Start`/`End` timestamp columns in the exported CSV. Defaults to UTC when omitted.

GdprKeyword.name: keyword
GdprKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring search applied with OR across id, ownerId, orgId, status, category, initiatedBy, description, macAddress and clientId. Timestamp fields are not searched.

GdprClientMac.name: clientMac
GdprClientMac.description: Client MAC address (hexadecimal, no separators) whose report file is to be downloaded.

GdprLogId.name: logID
GdprLogId.description: GDPR audit-log id to target. When omitted, the client id for `clientMac` is resolved from configDB and used instead.
